scripts.build: prisma generate && next build && cp -r .next/static .next/standalone/.next/ && cp -r public .next/standalone/ && mkdir -p .next/standalone/db .next/standalone/docs .next/standalone/data/reference && cp -r prisma .next/standalone/ && cp -r docs/dev-notes .next/standalone/docs/ && if [ -d data/reference/bible-guide ]; then cp -r data/reference/bible-guide .next/standalone/data/reference/; fi && for db in data/reference/*.sqlite; do if [ -f "$db" ]; then cp "$db" .next/standalone/data/reference/; fi; done
scripts.test: bun run pretest && DATABASE_URL_TEST=file:./db/eobom-test.db bun test tests/
scripts.pretest: echo 'DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS story_chunk_ai; DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS story_chunk_ad; DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS story_chunk_au; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS StoryChunkFts; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS StoryChunkFts_config; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS StoryChunkFts_content; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS StoryChunkFts_data; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS StoryChunkFts_docsize; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS StoryChunkFts_idx; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ReflectionEntryFts; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ReflectionEntryFts_config; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ReflectionEntryFts_content; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ReflectionEntryFts_data; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ReflectionEntryFts_docsize; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ReflectionEntryFts_idx; DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS reflection_entry_ai; DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS reflection_entry_ad; DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS reflection_entry_au;' | DATABASE_URL=file:./db/eobom-test.db DATABASE_URL_TEST=file:./db/eobom-test.db prisma db execute --stdin --schema prisma/schema.prisma; DATABASE_URL=file:./db/eobom-test.db DATABASE_URL_TEST=file:./db/eobom-test.db prisma db push --accept-data-loss --skip-generate && (DATABASE_URL=file:./db/eobom-test.db DATABASE_URL_TEST=file:./db/eobom-test.db prisma db execute --file prisma/fts5-setup.sql --schema prisma/schema.prisma || DATABASE_URL=file:./db/eobom-test.db DATABASE_URL_TEST=file:./db/eobom-test.db prisma db execute --file prisma/fts5-setup-fallback.sql --schema prisma/schema.prisma || (echo "CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS StoryChunkFts USING fts5(chunkId UNINDEXED, text, excerpt, summary, title, themes, tokenize = 'unicode61'); CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS story_chunk_ai AFTER INSERT ON StoryChunk BEGIN INSERT INTO StoryChunkFts (chunkId, text, excerpt, summary, title, themes) VALUES (new.id, new.text, new.excerpt, new.summary, new.title, new.themes); END; CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS story_chunk_ad AFTER DELETE ON StoryChunk BEGIN DELETE FROM StoryChunkFts WHERE chunkId = old.id; END; CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS story_chunk_au AFTER UPDATE ON StoryChunk BEGIN DELETE FROM StoryChunkFts WHERE chunkId = old.id; INSERT INTO StoryChunkFts (chunkId, text, excerpt, summary, title, themes) VALUES (new.id, new.text, new.excerpt, new.summary, new.title, new.themes); END; INSERT INTO StoryChunkFts (chunkId, text, excerpt, summary, title, themes) SELECT id, text, excerpt, summary, title, themes FROM StoryChunk;" | DATABASE_URL=file:./db/eobom-test.db DATABASE_URL_TEST=file:./db/eobom-test.db prisma db execute --stdin --schema prisma/schema.prisma))
scripts.test:unit: bun run pretest && DATABASE_URL_TEST=file:./db/eobom-test.db bun test tests/
scripts.test:seats: bun run pretest && DATABASE_URL_TEST=file:./db/eobom-test.db bun test tests/seats.test.ts
